title: The Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016.
full_text: null null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201611 Act Number: 11 Enactment Date: 2016-03-21 Act Year: 2016 Short Title: The Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. Long Title: An Act to provide for the establishment of a national standards body for the harmonious development of the activities of standardisation, conformity assessment and quality assurance of goods, articles, processes, systems and services and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Food ,Civil supplies and consumer protection Department Enforcement Date: 12-10-2017 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Department of Consumer Affairs) Location: Maharashtra Notification: 12th October 2017, vide Notification No. S.O.3295(E) dated 12th October 2017, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3 (ii).
